title: I-Avatar Medical ne-Kyber Zinikezwe Izigidi Ezingu-€3,7 Ukuze Kwandiswe Ukufinyelela Ezithombeni Zezokwelapha Ze-3D Ezicwilisayo Ezibhedlela
author: Jean-Baptiste Kempf

html:
Namuhla i-Avatar Medical ne-Kyber zimemezele ukuthi zinikezwe imali efika ezigidini ezingu-€3,7 ngohlelo lukahulumeni waseFrance i-France 2030 ukuze zithuthukise i-Avatar MediVerse, iphrojekthi eyakhelwe ukwenza izithombe zezokwelapha ze-3D ezicwilisayo, eziqondene nesiguli ngasinye, zitholakale noma kuphi lapho odokotela neziguli bezidinga khona.

Njengamanje, ukukhombisa isiguli noma udokotela ukwakheka komzimba nge-3D yangempela engadingi zibuko kudinga amandla amakhulu ekhompyutha atholakala eduze kwesikrini, okungakhawulela ukufinyelela emakamelweni ahlonyiswe ngokukhethekile kuphela. I-MediVerse yakhelwe ukuthutha lawo mandla ekhompyutha iwayise endaweni ekude bese isakaza lokho kuhlangenwe nakho kwe-3D okucwilisayo ngesikhathi sangempela. Udokotela ohlinzayo angakhombisa isiguli isimila asezosisusa ngesikhathi sokubonana naso, abuke kabusha lokho kwakheka komzimba okuqondene naleso siguli lapho ehlela ukuhlinza, aphinde angene nalowo mbono egumbini lokuhlinza.

I-Avatar MediVerse ihlanganisa ubuchwepheshe obubili baseFrance obuhambisanayo. I-Avatar Medical iletha i-Avatar Medical Vision, isofthiwe yayo egunyazwe yi-FDA futhi enophawu lwe-CE eguqula izithombe ezijwayelekile ze-CT ne-MRI zibe izithombe ze-3D ezisebenzisanayo nezibukeka njengezangempela ngaphandle kokudinga ukuhlukaniswa kwezingxenye ngesandla, kanye nolwazi elutholile ngokusebenza nezibhedlela ezingaphezu kuka-20 e-U.S. naseYurophu. I-Kyber inikeza ingqalasizinda yesikhathi sangempela enokubambezeleka okuncane kakhulu edweba futhi isakaze lokho kuhlangenwe nakho ikude.

Ngokungafani nokusakaza ividiyo evamile eyisicaba, ukuletha ukujula kwangempela kudinga ukuthumela isithombe esihlukile esweni ngalinye ngesikhathi sangempela, ngejubane elanele ukuthi ukwakheka komzimba kusabele ngokushesha lapho udokotela ekuhambisa noma ekuphendula ukuze akubone kangcono.

“Ukusebenzisana nezithombe zezokwelapha ngesikhathi sangempela kungenye yezinkinga zokubambezeleka ezinzima kakhulu ezikhona.” kusho uJean-Baptiste Kempf, i-CEO ye-Kyber. “Ukubambezeleka obekungeke kubonakale nhlobo ocingweni lwevidiyo kuphihliza isithombe sonke uma iso ngalinye lithola umbono walo. Ukuxazulula le nkinga yikho okwenza konke okunye kube nokwenzeka. Ngokuhlanganisa ukubonisa okucwilisayo kwe-Avatar Medical nengqalasizinda ye-Kyber yokusakaza ngesikhathi sangempela, i-MediVerse yakhelwe ukwenza lokho kusebenzisana kuhambe kahle ngaphandle kwezithiyo kuzo zonke izindawo namadivayisi. Kuyisibonelo esiqinile sendlela ubuchwepheshe obujulile obusungulwa eFrance obungabhekana ngayo nenselelo ebalulekile nengokoqobo emkhakheni wezempilo.”

Ku-Avatar Medical, i-MediVerse iyisinyathelo esibalulekile embonweni wayo obanzi wobuHlakani Bokubona Kwezokuhlinza, okuwukwenza ulwazi lokubona oluqondene nesiguli ngasinye lutholakale kulo lonke uhambo lokunakekelwa kokuhlinzwa, kunokuba ukubonisa okuthuthukile kuboshelwe esiteshini esisodwa somsebenzi noma egumbini elilodwa. Ngokuhlukanisa amandla ekhompyutha nendawo lapho izithombe zibukelwa khona, i-MediVerse ingenza ukubonisa kwe-3D okusebenzisanayo kukwazi ukwandiswa kalula ezibhedlela, ezinhlelweni zezempilo nasezindaweni zokunakekela ezisabalele ezindaweni ezahlukene.

“Sikhethe ukwakha lokhu ngobuchwepheshe besikhathi sangempela obuhamba phambili obukhona, futhi kwenzeke ukuthi bube ngobaseFrance,” kusho u-Elodie Litzler, iphini le-CEO nomunye wabasunguli be-Avatar Medical. “Akekho kithi obengakwazi ukukwenza lokhu eyedwa. Esikulangazelelayo akuwona nje umshini omusha ezibhedlela, kodwa wushintsho endleleni iziguli nodokotela abaqonda ngayo lokho abakubukayo, nasezindaweni lapho lokho kuqonda kungenzeka khona.”

Njengoba yakhelwe phezu kobuchwepheshe bomthombo ovulekile, le phrojekthi iphinde ihlose ukunika izibhedlela amandla amakhulu okulawula ingqalasizinda yazo futhi yehlise ukuncika kwazo ezinkundleni zobunikazi zokubonisa okukude.

Lo mklomelo unikezwe ngesimemo sephrojekthi se-France 2030 esibizwa ngokuthi “Ubuchwepheshe Obusha Bemihlaba Ebonakalayo Ecwilisayo” ngemuva kokuhlolwa yikomidi lochwepheshe elizimele, kanti i-Bpifrance yengamele ukuqaliswa kwalo egameni likahulumeni waseFrance.

Mayelana ne-Kyber

I-Kyber yinkampani yaseFrance yobuchwepheshe obujulile ethuthukisa ingqalasizinda yesikhathi sangempela yezempilo, yamarobhothi, yokudweba ngefu kanye nezinhlelo zevidiyo eziqhutshwa wubuhlakani bokwenziwa. Funda kabanzi ku-https://kyber.tech .

Mayelana ne-Avatar Medical

Yasungulwa ngo-2020, i-Avatar Medical ihola phambili kuBuhlakani Bokubona Kwezokuhlinza, yakha isixazululo esikwazi ukwandiswa esiguqula izithombe zezokwelapha zibe ulwazi lokubona olungasetshenziswa ngqo kulo lonke uhambo lokunakekelwa kokuhlinzwa. Isixazululo sayo esiwumgogodla, i-Avatar Medical Vision, siguqula izithombe ze-CT ne-MRI zibe izithombe ze-3D ezisebenzisanayo nezibukeka njengezangempela ngokushesha nangaphandle kokuhlukaniswa kwezingxenye, sinike odokotela indlela elula nengokwemvelo yokuqonda ukwakheka komzimba okuqondene nesiguli ngasinye, ukuhlela ukuhlinza, ukusebenzisana kanye nokuxhumana neziguli. Kusukela ekubonaneni nesiguli nasekuhleleni ngaphambi kokuhlinza kuze kufike egumbini lokuhlinza, inkampani isebenzela ukwenza ubuhlakani bokubona butholakale noma kuphi lapho kuthathwa khona izinqumo ezibucayi zokuhlinza. Njengoba isuka ocwaningweni olwenziwa e-Institut Curie nase-Institut Pasteur, i-Avatar Medical inemikhiqizo yobuchwepheshe egunyazwe yi-FDA futhi enophawu lwe-CE. Isebenza nezibhedlela ezingaphezu kuka-20 e-U.S. naseYurophu. Funda kabanzi ku-avatarmedical.ai .
